title: A Security ALLOW is evidence for one exact invocation, not a bearer capability
summary: SecurityInvocationEvidence binds invocation id, deterministic argument identity, context identity and observation time. SecurityInvocationGuard rejects stale evidence, argument/context substitution and replay. Successful exact Permission execution consumes the single-use Security validation.
invariants: Changing business arguments invalidates an earlier assessment even when object/method are unchanged.
Changing session/workspace context invalidates the assessment.
Permission denial does not consume otherwise-fresh Security evidence; successful exact ALLOW does.
The live Alchemy METHOD adapter derives identity from actual checkpoint arguments.
